clauses.scope_note: Section 6(a): Licensed Material; the Public License applies for the term of the licensed Copyright and Similar Rights, but rights terminate automatically if You fail to comply with the Public License.
clauses.condition_explanation: within_copyright_and_similar_rights_term means the term of the Copyright and Similar Rights licensed here has not expired. license_rights_not_automatically_terminated_by_noncompliance means You have not failed to comply with the Public License in a way that automatically terminates Your rights.

clauses.scope_note: Section 6(b)(1): rights to use Licensed Material that terminated under Section 6(a) reinstate automatically as of the cure date if the violation is cured within 30 days of discovery.
clauses.condition_explanation: rights_terminated_under_section_6a means the right to use the Licensed Material terminated under Section 6(a). violation_cured_within_30_days_of_discovery means the violation is cured no later than 30 days after You discover it. Reinstatement is automatic as of the date of cure when both predicates hold.

clauses.scope_note: Section 6(b)(2): an alternative to automatic reinstatement under Section 6(b)(1), for rights terminated under Section 6(a).
clauses.condition_explanation: rights_terminated_under_section_6a means the right to use the Licensed Material terminated under Section 6(a). licensor_expressly_reinstates_rights means the Licensor expressly reinstates those rights.

clauses.scope_note: Section 8(a): Licensed Material; the Public License does not reduce, limit, restrict, or impose conditions on uses that could lawfully be made without permission under the Public License.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_lawfully_possible_without_license_permission means the particular use could lawfully be made without permission under this Public License.

clauses.scope_note: Closing notice outside the Public License text: use of the Creative Commons name, other Creative Commons trademarks, or logos is not authorized without prior written consent, except for the limited purpose of indicating material is shared under a Creative Commons public license or as otherwise permitted by Creative Commons policies. The paragraph also says it does not form part of the public licenses.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_of_creative_commons_trademark_or_logo means using the Creative Commons trademark, another Creative Commons trademark, or a Creative Commons logo. limited_purpose_of_indicating_material_is_shared_under_creative_commons_public_license is the stated limited-purpose exception. otherwise_permitted_by_creative_commons_policies means the use is permitted by the policies referenced in the notice; those policies are not supplied. prior_written_consent_from_creative_commons means Creative Commons has given prior written consent. The restriction applies when none of these exceptions applies.

obligation_items.content: Refrain from using the Creative Commons trademark, another Creative Commons trademark, or a Creative Commons logo unless the use is for the limited stated purpose, is otherwise permitted by Creative Commons policies, or has prior written consent.
obligation_items.actor: person or entity making the trademark or logo use
obligation_items.object: Creative Commons name, other Creative Commons trademarks, or Creative Commons logos
obligation_items.trigger: A use of a covered trademark or logo that is not for the limited purpose of indicating material is shared under a Creative Commons public license, is not otherwise permitted by Creative Commons policies, and lacks prior written consent from Creative Commons.

coverage_notes: The supplied chunk does not include the operative provisions defining the full grant or compliance requirements; Section 6(a) refers to compliance with the Public License without reproducing those requirements.
The Creative Commons trademark notice references policies that are not supplied, so the scope of uses permitted by those policies cannot be specified.
Section 6(b) preserves any remedies the Licensor may have; that reservation does not itself impose a behavioral duty on the licensee.
The closing Creative Commons notice says it does not form part of the public licenses; its trademark-use restriction is nevertheless operative as a separate notice.
